firmCapacityTariffRemarks: The tariffs charged acc. Systemnutzungsentgeltverordnung (§ 3 GSNE-VO 2013):Baumgarten Entry FZK 0,77 EUR/kWh/h;Arnoldstein Entry DZK 0,62 EUR/kWh/h; Arnoldstein Exit FZK 4,63 EUR/kWh/h;Domestic Exit FZK 0,53 EUR/kWh/h; Domestic Exit FZK Carinthia 4,20 EUR/kWh/h
interruptibleCapacityTariffRemarks: An ex-post discount shall currently apply. In case of interruptions an amount equal to the transmission tariff subject to a compensation factor shall be refunded to the transport customer for the duration of the interruption.
auctionRemarks: Capacity shall be auctioned according to  Regulation (EU) No 984/2013 via PRISMA booking platform. The reserve price for each auction shall be the regulated tariff. Auction premium shall apply according to the auction algorithms if the total demand of available capacity is beyond the total offer.
generalTariffInformationRemarks: For transmission services the tariffs decreed by E-Control Commission with the Gas System Charges Ordinance (GSNE-VO in current version) shall apply. Tariffs for existing relevant points shall be fixed during the whole regulatory period and expressed in EUR/kWh/h. Multipliers apply for short term capacity products.
generalCapacityRemark: FZK - Freely allocable capacity enables firm transports in the entire market area and gives access to the virtual trading point. DZK - Capacity that can only be offered on a firm basis combining certain entry/exit points and as interruptible capacity combining all other entry/exit points and the virtual trading point. UK - Capacity that may be interrupted by the transmission system operator in accordance with the conditions stipulated in the transport contract.
firmTechnicalRemark: Firm capacity is guaranteed and may only be interrupted in cases of force majeure and planned maintenance. Firm technical refers to the maximum capacity that the TSO can offer.
firmBookedRemark: Firm booked refers to the capacity that has been contracted.
firmAvailableRemark: Firm available is the result of the difference between Firm Technical and Firm Booked.
interruptibleTotalRemark: Capacity that may be interrupted by the transmission system operator in accordance with the conditions stipulated in the capacity contract.
interruptibleBookedRemark: Interruptible booked refers to the capacity that has been contracted.
bMDailyImbalanceToleranceIsRemarks: Imbalance below 24MWh/d are carried to the beginning of the next Gas Day through a roll over account.
bMStatusInformation: Amount of gas in the system is published at start of each gas day and forecast of gas in the system at the end of each day and updated on an hourly basis. As required by Reg.715/2009 Annex I, Art. 3.4 (5).
bMStatusInformationFrequency: Hourly.  http://www.gasconnect.at/en/Market-Area-Manager
bMPenalties: Daily and hourly imbalances shall be settled at the gas exchange.  For hourly imbalance during the day an hourly incentive scheme for short position is applied. Please refer to the General Terms and Conditions of the MAM which can be found on their website. https://mgm.gasconnect.at/gca_mgm/mgm/downloads.do
bMCashOutRegime: Daily imbalances are settled each hour by the MAM . More information can be found on MAM's website. http://www.gasconnect.at/en/Market-Area-Manager
bMRemarks: If the daily imbalance of the BGR is bigger than 24 MWh/d, the MAM triggers exchange orders for hourly imbalance during the day by applying an hourly incentive scheme only for short position.

interruptibleTotalRemark: Interruptible level 1 services are offered at an interconnection point, on a yearly basis, when firm transmission services are available in limited quantity over such a period. If the offer of interruptible level 1 services is exhausted, interruptible level N services will be offered by Fluxys Belgium in unlimited quantity. These services have a higher probability of interruption than interruptible level 1 services and when needed are interrupted first.

tsoGeneralRemarks: All data published by Net4Gas are indicative and for information purposes only.
bMStatusInformation: Published balancing information follows national legislation. OTE (independent gas-market operator) shall execute balancing for "national transport". The TSO shall execute balancing for "transit" only. The TSO shall execute daily balancing based on preliminary values and monthly balancing for each day based on final values.
bMStatusInformationFrequency: By 13:00 of each day, the OTE shall notify the individual Shippers of preliminary values of Imbalances for the preceding Gas Day. By the 11th day of each month following the relevant Gas Month by 12:00 the OTE publishes the actual Imbalance. By 13:00 of each day, the TSO shall notify the individual Shippers of preliminary values of Imbalances for "transit" for the preceding Gas Day. By the 11th day of each month following the relevant Gas Month by 12:00 the TSO publishes the actual Imbalance, Unbalanced Imbalance, Residual Imbalance, off-tolerance Imbalance (and other data for) the relevant Gas Month for each Gas Day for each Shipper based on the actual gas quantity figures in the secured zone.

bMCashOutRegime: Missing balancing gas: Cpv + (0,20%*Cpv) at lest 4 EUR/MWh Excess balancing gas: Cpv - 4 EUR/MWh; minimum is 0,1 EUR/MWh Cpv = the fixed daily charge- please visit link please visit link "Price decision"http://www.eru.cz/cs/plyn/cenova-rozhodnuti/platna-cenova-rozhodnutiThe OTE shall pay the charge for excess balancing gas to shipper. bMStatusInformation: NetConnect Germany as market area manager is responsible for balancing. The Balancing  is based on allocation data and physical gas flows sent by the transmission system operator. NetConnect Germany publishes the aggregated state of balance of all balancing groups which are part of their market area at the beginning of each gas day. At the end of every gas day, they publish the prognosticated aggregated state of balance. In addition, each balancing group manager is responsible for balancing his balancing group. For this purpose, balancing group managers are provided with hourly time series about quantities allocated to a balancing group (information is provided per balancing account and respective sub-balancing groups).  For further information and precise figures please follow this link: https://www.net-connect-germany.de/en-gb/Transparency-information/Aggregate-Imbalance-Position

bMCashOutRegime: All revenue and expenditure items generated or incurred in connection with the settlement of daily and hourly energy imbalances, quantity reconciliation processes, system balancing activities and interest payments are booked to a balancing neutrality account.
